## English

- Fixes Harness version detection on the DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 Desktop shell, so Hosts started by the current Desktop app report `harnessVersion` again.
- Restores the version-gated workspace compatibility paths on 0.2.0 Hosts, fixing the Remote Web file-change subscription and byte-range file reads.
- Publishes the Android APK as version `0.4.24` with Android `versionCode 35`.

## 中文

- 修复 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 Desktop 外壳下的 Harness 版本探测，当前 Desktop 启动的 Host 会重新上报 `harnessVersion`。
- 恢复 0.2.0 Host 上按版本生效的 Workspace 兼容路径，修复 Remote Web 的文件变化订阅与字节范围读取。
- 发布版本 `0.4.24` 的 Android APK（Android `versionCode 35`）。

[Full changelog / 完整改动](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote/compare/v0.4.23...v0.4.24) · [Installation / 安装说明](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote/blob/v0.4.24/README.md)
